title: Are there more obese or more underweight adults in the world?
subtitle: Two head-to-head rounds: too thin or obese, which is more common among the world's adults? Then see the year the two lines crossed.
notes: OWID has no world underweight series after 2014 (NCD-RisC 2017 charts, average of men and women); both lines end 2014, obesity continued as a dashed link to 2024 (16.4%). Crossing about 2007 in the OWID series. Nearly tripled = OWID 6.1% (1990) to 16.4% (2024), 2.7x. Compare cards ignore y and stay pinned under the heading; size 2 used; the reveal numbers are engine-small and the winner of each pair is not marked.
